units.statement_en: Ibn Kathir attributes to Ibn Abbas and Ikrima the view that Quran 108:3 was revealed concerning Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf and a group of Quraysh unbelievers.
units.arabic_anchor: وقال ابن عباس أيضا وعكرمة نزلت في كعب بن الأشرف وجماعة من كفار قريش

source_locator.scope: I09R01 abbreviated attribution before al-Bazzar narrative

units.statement_en: Ibn Kathir reports through the cited al-Bazzar chain that Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf preferred Quraysh in their comparison with Muhammad, followed by the reported revelation of Quran 108:3.
units.arabic_chain_anchor: وقال البزار حدثنا زياد بن يحيى الحساني حدثنا بن أبي عدي عن داود عن عكرمة عن ابن عباس
